extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the analysis: (1) 'island' had inconsistent spacing in 'Biscoe ' and ' Biscoe', which were normalized; (2) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas (e.g., '4,350'), which was converted to numeric; (3) three rows (1, 4, 12) had implausibly high body mass values (3,800,000 and 3,150,000) and were excluded; (4) one row (21) had a negative flipper length (-187), which was excluded; (5) two exact duplicate rows were removed. After these fixes, the average body mass for females is 4050.93 g and for males is 4962.50 g.
